description:
Yun I-So, a twenty-seven-year-old lunchbox owner raising a seven-year-old child alone, finds herself in a difficult situation. One day, Hae-Jun, a man who suddenly appears in her life, hovers by her side like a friend or a lover. I-So, who has been living a peaceful life, eagerly accepting Hae-Jun's affection, begins to feel anxious about losing his present happiness when the past relationships that shook his life upside down seven years ago reappear. As time passes, he begins to realize that there's something strange about Hae-Jun, who used to protect him... Was it a mistake to step foot into his garden in the first place?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
